register.labelZh: PACK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: PACK 片語動詞可以表示很多人擠進細小地方,或在短時間內安排大量活動。；電影可以 pack in the crowds,而歌手或樂隊則可以 pack out a hall,表示活動吸引了大批觀眾。；衣物可以 pack away,而人們也可以 pack things away 或 pack up,表示收拾物品或準備離開。；你可以 pack in 一份工作或活動;機器停止運作時,則可以說它 packs up。
register.summaryEn: PACK expressions can show many people entering a small place or many activities being fitted into a short period. A film can pack in the crowds, while a singer or band can pack out a hall. Clothes can pack away neatly, and people can pack things away or pack up before leaving. You can pack in a job or activity, while a machine packs up when it stops working.
